source.author: verg
source.text: Nunc, O numquam frustrata vocatus hasta meos, nunc tempus adest: te maximus Actor te Turni nunc dextra gerit.
source.text_original: 'Nunc, O numquam frustrata vocatus / hasta meos, nunc tempus adest: te maximus Actor / te Turni nunc dextra gerit.
source.text_english: Now, O spear, never vain to my summons, now the time has come: great Actor’s son bears you now, and Turnus bears you now in his right hand.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: tempus adest; age rumpe moras; dumque aequore toto currimus, incertus si nubila duxerit aether, iam nunc mitte metus fidens superisque mihique.
reuse.text_original: tempus adest; age rumpe moras; dumque aequore toto / currimus, incertus si nubila duxerit aether, / iam nunc mitte metus fidens superisque mihique.
reuse.text_english: The time is at hand; come, break off delays; and while we are speeding over the whole sea, unsure whether the sky may have drawn up clouds, now at once put aside your fears and trust in the gods above and in me.
